title: Isandro and the Safehouse
author: Theo Dunmore
blurb: Edmund Ravensworth, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
